Definition: to suck; causatively, to give milk
BiblicalUsage: 1) to suckle, nurse, suck; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to suck; 1a2) suckling, babe (subst); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to give suck to, nurse; 1b2) nursing, nursing woman, nurse (participle)
